bug_semantics: MessagePack Lz4Block/Lz4BlockArray decompression feeds attacker-controlled LZ4 bytes into a vendored LZ4 r93 fast decoder (LZ4_uncompress_32/64) that accepts only destination length. The decoder walks tokens, literal extra-length bytes (0xFF runs), 2-byte match offsets, and match extra-length bytes via an unbounded src_p pointer with no src_end. A crafted payload (regression: ext type 99 / Lz4Block with token 0xF0 plus truncated 0xFF extras) forces native reads past the compressed buffer, raising AccessViolationException (process-killing DoS) and potentially disclosing adjacent memory before the post-decode consumed-length check. CWE-20/CWE-125; CVSS 8.2.
